content: Motivated by these problems, we propose to extend the NSP task with previous sentence prediction (PSP). Despite its simplicity, empirical results show that this is beneficial for downstream tasks, including both NLI and MRC tasks. To further incorporate the document-level information, the scope is also expanded to include more surrounding sentences, not just the adjacent. The method is briefly illustrated in Fig. FIGREF6.
